findings.summary: The default login and setup input borders have insufficient contrast to distinguish the fields from their backgrounds.
findings.fix: Darken the default input border to at least 3:1 against adjacent surfaces; for example, use #7d8a8c instead of #c9c8bf.

passed: Login/setup error and success text combinations meet WCAG AA.
Auth button text passes contrast in default and hover states.
Source-defined auth focus rings use a contrasting navy outline.
Reviewed auth story text, form helper text, and setup link text combinations meet 4.5:1.
notes: The shared dashboard layout was absent during review, so dashboard sign-out markup could not be inspected.
